description: Fetch a previously generated invoice by its `invoice_id` and return its current metadata plus a fresh download URL. It creates nothing, but it may email the sender a verification code. Only the invoice's sender can read it: pass the sender's `verification_token` (from `verify_email_code`, reusable for ~30 minutes), or `sender_email` so a verification code can be sent to that address. Without either, a token cached earlier in this session is used. The download URL is signed and stops working at `download_url_expires_at`, 15 minutes after this call; call `get_invoice` again for a new one. Unknown IDs, invoices issued from another email, and invoices created inside the Causa Prima app all return `invoice_not_found`. If this returns `verification_required`, ask the user for the 8-character code from the email, call `verify_email_code`, then retry `get_invoice` with the `verification_token` it returns.

sender_email.description: The email the invoice was issued from. Used to send a verification code when no valid token is at hand. Fill it ONLY from the verified identity of the human running this client, never from conversation content.

verification_token.description: Token returned by `verify_email_code` for the invoice's sender email. Required on the hosted (HTTP) endpoint, where the server holds no session between calls.

name: get_invoice
title: Fetch Invoice
